Dupli-Arms Quirk.name: Dupli-Arms Quirk
Dupli-Arms Quirk.description:
👐 You have six arms and grow copies of your own body parts on four.

🌱 At the start you hold several objects, put an eye around a corner or bring an ear near a sound, with copied parts attached to your four extra arms.
📈 With training: broader scouting, multi-arm restraints, shielding a group, building-wide rescue coordination.
⚠️ Your parts cannot detach or cross walls; eyes need light and a clear view, injuries hurt you, and several views or loud sounds overwhelm your attention.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Sensory Overload, as extra eyes and ears compete for your attention.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Mezo Shoji's Dupli-Arms. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Noise-filtering earpieces

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Corner Eye, Many Hand Hold
Dupli-Arms Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: four extra side limbs; their tips copy the user's hands, eyes, ears or mouths, linked to their senses. Start: carry several objects, offer hands, peek around corners, eavesdrop at range. More parts at once, hard rescue or combat need training.
Limits: limbs reach around, never detach or pass walls. Copies are own organs only, no new powers. Eyes need light and sight lines; loud noise swamps ears. Hurt limbs or copies pain the user; several views or sounds split attention. Limbs heal; damage costs time and strength.
Quirk Strain: light: one copy, extra grip; moderate: several senses, climb, restraint; heavy: many limbs, shielding a group; severe: signature effort, building-wide coordination.
Drawback: built in, the canon Sensory Overload.
Canon: Mezo Shoji's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: extra senses grant no right to intrude; user answers for every limb.
Look: extra arms.
